## What changed?

Describe the user-facing or maintenance change and why it is needed.

## How was it tested?

- [ ] Ran `npm test` when applicable.
- [ ] Checked the affected behavior manually in a browser when applicable.
- [ ] Confirmed existing behavior remains intact.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and avoids unrelated edits.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if behavior or setup instructions changed.
- [ ] Accessibility and keyboard behavior were considered for UI changes.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or unnecessary personal data were added.
